topic: What antenna designs balance aerodynamic constraints with MIMO requirements for high-speed aircraft communication?
consensus_response: Conformal antennas and phased arrays balance aerodynamics with MIMO requirements. Metamaterials and frequency-selective surfaces enhance performance by reducing interference. CFD simulations optimize antenna placement, minimizing drag while maintaining signal quality. Digital beamforming algorithms adaptively optimize signal directivity, improving SINR and SNR.
reference_context: Antenna design must consider mission constraints, space environment, and cost. Link budget analysis and modular designs are crucial for inter-satellite communications.
